description: This file defines a Go package for Kubernetes client apply configurations related to the IngressClass resource in v1beta1 API version. It includes a struct for declarative configuration, functions to construct and extract configurations, and chainable methods to set metadata and spec fields.

classes.name: IngressClassApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A declarative configuration for Kubernetes IngressClass resource, supporting chainable setters for metadata and spec.

methods.name: IngressClass
methods.description: Constructs a new IngressClassApplyConfiguration with specified name, default kind and API version.

methods.name: ExtractIngressClassFrom
methods.description: Extracts the applied configuration owned by a specific field manager from an IngressClass object, optionally for a subresource.

methods.name: ExtractIngressClass
methods.description: Extracts the applied configuration owned by a specific field manager from an IngressClass object.

methods.name: IsApplyConfiguration
methods.description: Indicates that this struct is an apply configuration.

methods.name: WithKind
methods.description: Sets the Kind field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithAPIVersion
methods.description: Sets the APIVersion field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithName
methods.description: Sets the Name in the metadata of the configuration.

methods.name: WithGenerateName
methods.description: Sets the GenerateName in the metadata.

methods.name: WithNamespace
methods.description: Sets the Namespace in the metadata.

methods.name: WithUID
methods.description: Sets the UID in the metadata.

methods.name: WithResourceVersion
methods.description: Sets the ResourceVersion in the metadata.

methods.name: WithGeneration
methods.description: Sets the Generation in the metadata.

methods.name: WithCreationTimestamp
methods.description: Sets the CreationTimestamp in the metadata.

methods.name: WithDeletionTimestamp
methods.description: Sets the DeletionTimestamp in the metadata.

methods.name: WithDeletionGracePeriodSeconds
methods.description: Sets the DeletionGracePeriodSeconds in the metadata.

methods.name: WithLabels
methods.description: Adds or updates labels in the metadata.

methods.name: WithAnnotations
methods.description: Adds or updates annotations in the metadata.

methods.name: WithOwnerReferences
methods.description: Adds owner references to the metadata.

methods.name: WithFinalizers
methods.description: Adds finalizers to the metadata.

methods.name: ensureObjectMetaApplyConfigurationExists
methods.description: Ensures the ObjectMetaApplyConfiguration is initialized.

methods.name: WithSpec
methods.description: Sets the Spec field in the configuration.

methods.name: GetKind
methods.description: Retrieves the Kind value from the configuration.

methods.name: GetAPIVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the APIVersion value from the configuration.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Retrieves the Name from the metadata.

methods.name: GetNamespace
